rejected_rule.statement: Payments made under a mistake of law are generally not recoverable, unless there is something more in addition to the mistake of law that shows the defendant's primary responsibility for the mistake.
rejected_rule.supporting_quote: "It is not correct to say that money paid under a mistake of law can never be recovered back. The true proposition is that money paid under a mistake of law, by itself and without more, cannot be recovered back. If there is something more in addition to a mistake of law-if there is something in the defendant's conduct which shows that, of the two of them he is the one primarily responsible for the mistake-then it may be recovered back."
